title: M7b1 production routing adapter implementation and proof
instructions: Implement the missing production-capable query-entry routing adapter for daily_basic/month=2026-05 without enabling a production pointer switch. Inspect C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading/server/db/duckdb-client.mjs and existing DuckDB consumers. Add a reusable adapter module near duckdb-client.mjs; do not change duckdb-client.mjs or default production behavior in this task. The adapter must support an artifact-local candidate pointer and a future production pointer path. For daily_basic, expose a routed view or query helper with canonical columns ts_code, trade_date, turnover_rate, volume_ratio, pe, pb, ps, total_mv, circ_mv, source, ingest_run_id. For 2026-05-01 <= trade_date < 2026-06-01, route to the quality-passed Parquet manifest. For dates outside that window, route to main.daily_basic in the source DuckDB connection opened OPEN_READONLY. Invalid or missing date predicates must not silently route to Parquet. Cross-window reads must be deterministic and schema-compatible; if implemented as a view, it must use main.daily_basic for source fallback to avoid recursive self-reference. Write proof artifacts showing route behavior, row counts for pilot window, outside-window fallback smoke, invalid/missing-date behavior, and zero production pointer writes. Run targeted Quanttrading tests for the adapter. Do not write metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json. Do not write data/clean/daily_basic/_current.json. Do not modify target Parquet or the quality-passed clean manifest. Do not create T7b2/T7b3/T7b4/T7c/M8 task files. Finish for Claude review.
summary: T7b1 additive query-entry router implemented in Quanttrading without modifying duckdb-client.mjs. Targeted Vitest passed (1 file, 5 tests). Adapter-proof artifact passed using real DuckDB OPEN_READONLY: pilot window routes to quality-passed Parquet with 75018 rows, before/after outside-window ranges route to source-duckdb and match direct source profiles, cross-window route splits Parquet+source, invalid date rejected, missing date unresolved. Production query-entry pointer and _current remain absent; source DuckDB size/mtime, clean manifest, and target Parquet are unchanged. No T7b2/T7b3/T7b4/T7c/M8 task files were created.
